verdicts.label: A
verdicts.evidence: For n=26, there exists a family of 15 subsets of a set of 56 elements such that the union of any 7 of them has size >= 26, but no 3 of them have a non-empty intersection. For example, a random graph with 15 vertices and 56 edges typically has a maximum subgraph of size 8 with about 20 edges, meaning the union of any 7 subsets has size 56 - 20 = 36 >= 26.
